tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Primary screen background, feed rows, and tab bar. Light maps to UIKit systemBackground; dim is rgb(.18,.18,.20); black is pure OLED black.

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Quote cards (RecordEmbedView), grouped cells, and secondary panels on `bg`.

tokens.name: bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Third-level fills inside `bg-secondary`: nested rows and inset fields.

tokens.name: bg-grouped
tokens.usage: Settings and other grouped-list screens. In dim it sits darker than `bg`.

tokens.name: elevated-low
tokens.usage: Elevation step 1 in the themed elevation ladder. Use for hover and pressed rows.

tokens.name: elevated-medium
tokens.usage: Elevation step 2: cards that float over `bg`.

tokens.name: elevated-high
tokens.usage: Elevation step 3: menus anchored to content.

tokens.name: elevated-modal
tokens.usage: Sheet and modal backgrounds (themedSheetBackground).

tokens.name: elevated-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and context menus, the top of the elevation ladder.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Display names, post body, and titles on `bg`, `bg-secondary`, and every elevated surface. Increase Contrast raises it to #fafafa in dim and #ffffff in black.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Handles, timestamps, repost headers, and metadata on `bg` and `bg-secondary`. Light is UIKit secondaryLabel.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders and de-emphasized hints only, never for content people need to read. KNOWN CONTRAST MISS (kept exact from source): in light it is about 1.9:1 on `bg`, and in dim #737373 is 2.8:1 on #2e2e33. Black passes at 5.3:1. High Contrast themes fix this: #4a4a50 is 8.8:1 on white, and #c4c4ca is 9.8:1 on #1c1c20.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels. Exempt from contrast minimums because it marks an inactive state.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between feed rows and list cells (themedDivider). Use 0.5px.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Standard 1px outline on cards and inputs. Light is UIKit systemGray5.

tokens.name: border-prominent
tokens.usage: Emphasized outlines on focused fields and selected chips. Light is UIKit systemGray3.

tokens.name: embed-stroke
tokens.usage: The 1pt outline on link cards and quote cards (Color.gray at 30%).

tokens.name: thread-line
tokens.usage: The 2pt vertical reply-thread connector in the 54pt avatar column (UIKit systemGray4).

tokens.name: thread-dot
tokens.usage: The 4pt ellipsis dots in a collapsed thread gap (UIKit systemGray3).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Catbird Blue: the brand color and the asset-catalog AccentColor (display-p3). Use it for tint, filled buttons, the compose FAB glass tint, and outgoing chat bubbles. CONTRAST: 3.0:1 against `on-accent` white, so only bold text 19px and up or icons go on it. Large or bold text only on `bg` in dim (4.4:1). In High Contrast it deepens to #0038b8 (9.3:1 with white `on-accent`). In HC Dark it lightens to #9cc0ff with black `on-accent` (11.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: AccentTextColor: links, @mentions, hashtags, and 'N more replies'. Use it on `bg` and `bg-secondary`: 5.2:1 in light and 6.9:1 in black. In dim it is 4.4:1 on `bg`, just under AA, so it is kept exact and flagged here. High Contrast themes fix this: #0038b8 is 9.3:1 in HC Light, and #a9c9ff is 10.1:1 in HC Dark.

tokens.name: accent-gradient-partner
tokens.usage: The second stop of the brand gradient (135deg, `accent` to this). Use it only for marketing and brand surfaces, never in app chrome.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `accent` fills: Follow button label, FAB glyphs, toast text. Black in High Contrast Dark, where `accent` is light.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` fills: the LIVE badge and tab-bar badges. Black in High Contrast Dark, where `danger` is light. Black in Color-Blind Safe Dark too, where `danger` is light.

tokens.name: icon-gradient-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the app-icon background gradient (display-p3 0, .189, .548). Use it only for brand art.

tokens.name: icon-gradient-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the app-icon background gradient, reached at 70% of the height.

tokens.name: accent-twilight
tokens.usage: Twilight accent palette (Settings > Appearance). Swaps for `accent` and `accent-text` when the person picks it.

tokens.name: accent-lavender
tokens.usage: Lavender accent palette. The light value is 4.0:1 on white, so use it for tint and icons.

tokens.name: accent-sunrise
tokens.usage: Sunrise accent palette. Light #ff955e is 2.3:1 on white, so never use it for small text; the app uses it as tint only.

tokens.name: accent-aurora
tokens.usage: Aurora accent palette. The light value is 2.8:1 on white, so use it as tint only.

tokens.name: accent-dusk
tokens.usage: Dusk accent palette.

tokens.name: accent-midnight
tokens.usage: Midnight accent palette. It has the strongest light-mode contrast at 7.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: like
tokens.usage: Active like heart and its count (SwiftUI .red). Pair it with the filled `heart.fill` glyph so the state never depends on hue alone. Color-Blind Safe and High Contrast themes swap this for a vermillion (Okabe & Ito) so like and repost differ on the blue–orange axis.

tokens.name: repost
tokens.usage: Active repost glyph and count (SwiftUI .green). Pair it with the weight change so the state is not hue alone. Color-Blind Safe and High Contrast themes swap this for a blue (Okabe & Ito). It sits close to `verified` and `accent` in hue, but it only ever colors the repost glyph and count.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Verification checkmark badge (SwiftUI .blue). It is a different blue from `accent`, so do not substitute one for the other.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, the offline banner, and the LIVE badge. Color-Blind Safe and High Contrast themes swap this for a vermillion (Okabe & Ito), so danger and `success` differ on the blue–orange axis.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success states and the E2EE encryption shield on MLS chats. Color-Blind Safe and High Contrast themes swap this for a blue (Okabe & Ito), so the encryption shield and confirmations leave the red–green axis.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Error and empty-state triangles (ErrorStateView), and the Muted profile-button stroke. Color-Blind Safe and High Contrast themes move this off the orange axis so it never collides with the vermillion `danger`: an Okabe & Ito reddish purple (#6e2058) in the light ones, where every dark amber readable at 4.5:1 collapses onto vermillion under protanopia (simulated ΔE2000 under 6), and an Okabe & Ito yellow in the dark ones. The triangle glyph still carries the meaning.

tokens.name: bubble-outgoing
tokens.usage: Your messages in MLS chat. Text in them uses `on-accent`.

tokens.name: bubble-incoming
tokens.usage: Other people's messages (white at 93% in light, white at 22% in dark). Text in them uses `text-primary`.

tokens.name: glass-overlay
tokens.usage: Subtle white wash over glass in light and dim (medium 0.08, strong 0.12). It is clear in black mode.

tokens.name: scrim-warning
tokens.usage: Content-warning overlay behind blurred media. Use `on-accent` white text on it.

styles.name: nav-large-title
styles.usage: Large navigation titles: SF Pro at wdth 120, wght 700, optical size equal to the scaled size. On the web: `--font-expanded` plus `font-stretch: 120%`. Serif drops weight 100 (to a minimum of 400); rounded adds 50.

styles.name: nav-inline-title

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: title3: big action-row icons and card titles.
